top_choice_rationale: P002 rewards a new organising concept, the Z2 classification of time-reversal-invariant insulators with helical edge states, followed within two years by a falsifiable experimental observation in HgTe and independent confirmation in several material families; it is two decades old and maps onto three names, provided the citation is scoped to the Kane-Mele prediction and the first observation and explicitly leaves out the HgTe proposal and 3D topological insulators. P001 is a close second: a distinct, verified invention with a clean two-name credit, though I still weigh a new concept above the best realisation of a measurement idea. P003 is deep but younger, with unsettled superconductivity and credit questions, and I prefer it to no award.
